case_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the evaluation case

dataset.description: Source dataset name and version, e.g. ibm_amlsim_v1 or ragas_grounded_v1

scenario_id.description: Identifier of the scenario or network topology

cluster_id.description: Identifier of the network cluster or independent customer group for cluster-aware bootstrapping

typology.description: AMLSim typology label if applicable. Kept isolated from investigation evidence.

related_transaction_ids.description: Known related transactions in the ground truth graph

ground_truth_label.description: External ground truth label. Strictly withheld from model prompts and evidence.

ground_truth_edges.description: Known suspicious or benign transaction graph edges

expected_evidence_ids.description: Set of evidence IDs expected to be retrieved for complete grounding

expected_abstention.description: Whether the engine is expected to abstain/escalate due to missing or degraded evidence

user_query.description: Optional human or investigator query for Ragas evaluation

reference_answer.description: Deterministic ground-truth reference summary for answer evaluation

metadata.description: Scenario specific attributes (seed, bank_id, step range, etc.)
